settings.executionWarmupScope: untimed full encoder and explicit-KV decode on the same runtime, encoder context, and decoder context immediately before each measured request; state resets to the blocked P=1 sentinel
settings.sampleIsolation: fresh Python process and fresh ONNX Runtime encoder/decoder sessions; fresh native child process/runtime
settings.timingBoundary: encoder/decoder execution includes shape binding, provider execution, GPU completion synchronization through required small-output readback, and owned output snapshot; explicit KV remains device-resident during measured WebGPU requests and its correctness readback is untimed; process startup, load/compile, preprocessing, tokenization, and same-context warmup are excluded; processWall includes process preparation and warmup and is not an inference-latency comparison

onnxRuntime.comparisonLabel: non-strict accelerator-first with exact executed-node placement
onnxRuntime.placementEvidence: separate untimed profiling sessions and strict CPU-EP-disabled session-create probes execute after each measured request; measured sessions are not profiled

settings.dynamicShapeQualification: one untimed fresh process/runtime/session per precision and selected VolvoxAI GPU backend before per-sample execution warmup

parity.accuracyEvidence: single-workload exact greedy-output agreement; this is not a corpus-level accuracy metric
parity.numericTensorParity: not compared across runtimes; each runtime independently checks finite logits/caches and exact preservation of its own cache prefix
